name: get_document_history
description: List the saved git history and original-file availability for a session (newest first, read-only: never mutates, never flips dirty). Paginate with limit (1-100, default 20) and offset (default 0). Returns {ok:true,sessionId,documentPath,currentCommit,totalCommits,history:[{oid,message,author,timestamp,timestampMs,opCount,affectedNodeIds,resultingHeadOid}]} (timestampMs = ms-precision epoch millis; commit-time clock for tracked commits, git seconds for older ones; opCount is always present (0 for pre-tracking commits and heals-only saves: it folds operations, not normalizer rewrites); affectedNodeIds is always present ([] when untracked); resultingHeadOid always equals oid (append-only; refs never move). Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc","limit":10} -> history slice. Use the oids with revert_document (or preview_revert first) to restore an earlier saved state.
